name: Punchcard
description: A punched card: rows of rectangular holes with the unpunched positions left blank.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M0 0 H100 V100 H0 Z M12 16 H26 V38 H12 Z M40 16 H54 V38 H40 Z M68 16 H82 V38 H68 Z M12 60 H26 V82 H12 Z M40 60 H54 V82 H40 Z M68 60 H82 V82 H68 Z; fill-rule: evenodd; fill: #000 }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M0 0 H100 V100 H0 Z M12 16 H26 V38 H12 Z M40 16 H54 V38 H40 Z M68 16 H82 V38 H68 Z M12 60 H26 V82 H12 Z M40 60 H54 V82 H40 Z M68 60 H82 V82 H68 Z; fill-rule: evenodd; fill: #000 }); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
